chunks: With this chain of transmission, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Ḥammād, from Ḥarīz, from Zurārah, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

There is no salat except with taharah, and for istinja', three stones suffice you; upon that the sunnah (prophetic tradition) of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم has proceeded. But as for urine, then it must necessarily be washed.

key_terms.ثَلَاثَةُ أَحْجَارٍ: three stones used for cleansing in istinja'
key_terms.صَلَاةَ: salat (prayer), whose validity depends on ritual purity
key_terms.طَهُورٍ: ritual purity or purification required for salat

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about taharah for salat and the ruling of istinja' with stones?
ai.summary: This hadith states that salat requires ritual purity and gives a legal ruling concerning istinja'. It affirms that cleansing with three stones suffices in a relevant case according to the sunnah (prophetic tradition) of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, while urine requires washing.
